latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Export and download AI-generated videos in 1080p MP4 format, fast and server-side.

- Upload AI-processed videos and receive high-quality 1080p MP4 files in 20-40 seconds.
- No need for complex export settings—just describe your request in plain language.
- Automated session management, including fallback to anonymous tokens with free starter credits.
- Supports export, credits check, timeline state, and uploads through simple chat commands.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering; all major video and audio formats supported.
- Clear feedback and guidance for unsupported files, errors, and typical video workflows.
